name: fundraising-fundamentals
description: Fundraising Fundamentals: what fundraising actually is, the universal structure and the narrative, running the process, the capital ladder, instruments (priced rounds, convertible notes, SAFEs), dilution and cap table mathematics, term sheet economics including liquidation preference, control and governance, non-dilutive and debt financing, diligence, private company valuation, secondaries and exits, why and how companies go public, IPO mechanics and alternatives, post-IPO raising, public debt, securities regulation, and the non-profit side — the revenue model, the donor pyramid and major gifts, grants, capital campaigns, individual and recurring giving, and metrics and the overhead myth.
